Samir Patel: Heads-up — AcmeBio asking for 45% off on a 2yr dedicated + private deploy. POC week of Apr 5. Need deal-desk approval & security pre-reqs. They're handling PHI-ish data. @Claire Wong can you confirm pricing floor?
Claire Wong: 35% is our standard max for this ARR band. For Private we usually add enterprise support + 15% uplift. Can we propose 30% POC credit then commit to 40% on signature with 2yr?
Jordan Lee: For POC we can spin a hosted dedicated pool (no infra handover) — reduces ops cost. Technical ask: they want BYOK/KMS + HIPAA-aware logging. That increases delivery timeline a bit.
Priya Menon: From deal desk — we can't do 45 outright. We can approve up to 40% but with conditions: 1) 18–24 month minimum; 2) Premium Support must be purchased; 3) non-refundable tiered commit; 4) KMS + SOC2 attestation language in SOW. Also need margin floor calc: ensure net margin >= 18%. I need ARR + tokens/mo to run numbers.
Samir Patel: ARR estimate ~ $380k ARR yr1, grows to $1.1M yr2 with projected usage. Tokens/month ~ 120B. QPS peak ~ 120 r/s. Is that enough for 40%?
Priya Menon: Send me the forecast + expected QPS by EOD. If the utilization and ARR look like that, 40% is workable with the conditions above. If not, we revert to 35%. Posting proposed concession language below.
Priya Menon: ```Proposed concession: 40% off list pricing on hosted inference + private deploy for 24 months. Conditions: (a) Customer commits to minimum monthly spend of $24,000; (b) Premium Support subscription (SLA 99.9% + 24/7 coverage); (c) Customer provides KMS/HSM proof-of-possession and SOC2 Type II attestation within 60 days of signature; (d) Concession revokes if usage < 80% of committed spend for two consecutive months. No retroactive credits.```
Claire Wong: I'll loop in Maya (Legal) to review the clause re: attestation and data-residency. @Maya Gupta (Legal) can you take a look?
Jordan Lee: I'll own the security questionnaire and KMS integration timeline. Estimate 5 business days to complete the security Q and 3 weeks for KMS POC in staging (eng-platform support needed).
DealDesk Bot: Ticket #DD-2026-487 created to track approval. Link: https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-2026-487 
Maya Gupta (Legal): Quick note — Pricing language looks OK in principle, pending standard indemnities and any data residency specifics. I'll push a redline within 48 hours.
Samir Patel: Thanks everyone — I'll nudge the customer and push the POC start to Apr 12 to allow for legal + deal desk sign-off. If we have to trim concession, prefer to start POC rather than stall deal. :thumbsup:
Priya Menon: Agreed — fallback offer: 35% + 30% POC credit. Keep me posted with final usage numbers.
Claire Wong: I'll update the customer with tentative terms today and share the DealDesk ticket. Jordan/Maya looped. /cc DealDesk Bot
